headline: Bring your squad into {{The Phantom Pain}}. Up to {{16 players}}.
summary: Joint Operations adds online multiplayer to the single-player game. The host runs the missions. Up to 15 clients share the session: the same open world, the same missions and the same Mother Base.
It's free, it's open source, and it never touches Konami's servers.
